title: Miso salmon bites
ingredients: 4, 6 oz filets of wild salmon cut into bites
instructions: Prep all ingredients for Miso salmon bites: 4, 6 oz filets of wild salmon cut into bites, 1/2 cup shiro miso (white), 1/2 cup white sugar, 1/2 cup dry sake.

Cook and assemble according to the doc method: 4, 6 oz filets of wild salmon cut into bites 1/2 cup shiro miso (white) 1/2 cup white sugar 1/2 cup dry sake 1/4 cup soy sauce Sesame seeds roasted Green onion Note: 2 tbsp each for one 6 oz filet Mix the marinade Mix in the salmon 1 hr in fridge Save marinade, add to parchment, put some extra marinade Bake 400 for a few mins Glaze with more marinade, flip, glaze Bake til done.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and acidity to taste and serve hot.
